findings.title: A newly created nested runner root is returned before every directory link is durable

evidence.source: TopicObservationRunner.__init__ calls self.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) before the component-wise durable creation used by the artifact and literature stores. pathlib.mkdir(parents=True) does not fsync each newly modified immediate parent, and this branch has no error-propagating fsync call.
evidence.reproduction: With only root-durability-resolved pre-existing, construction of root-durability-resolved/new/nested completed and initialized storage. Instrumented real fsync calls covered new/nested, its literature directory, and its artifacts directory, but omitted root-durability-resolved and root-durability-resolved/new. A crash can therefore lose either runner-root directory entry after successful construction.

findings.repair: Create the runner root component by component from the nearest existing ancestor and fsync each component's immediate parent immediately after mkdir. Propagate mkdir/fsync failures before any runner state is exposed. Add a regression that begins with a genuinely absent multi-component root, asserts exact fsync order, and injects failure at each parent fsync.

findings.title: Pre-import budget evidence rejects a legitimate strictly-later PENDING-to-OBSERVED recovery

evidence.source: The pre-import exhausted-budget branch records MANUAL_QUEUE evidence with import_disposition null even when it references a persisted PENDING observation. Historical-upgrade validation accepts budget MANUAL_QUEUE evidence only when import_disposition equals PENDING, so it excludes this reachable branch.
evidence.reproduction: Seed OBS-PRE as restricted PENDING, run zero-budget c0->c1, then submit an OPEN c1->c2 retry with the same observation ID, idempotency key, logical identity, digest, and bytes. Literature durably advances OBS-PRE to OBSERVED with a verified artifact, but the topic run raises 'stored item evidence observation status conflicts with literature' because the older evidence has import_disposition null.

findings.repair: Represent pre-import versus post-import budget evidence explicitly and admit the pre-import historical upgrade only when a strictly later validated cursor-chain batch proves the same observation ID, idempotency key, logical identity, and digest with a verified artifact. Preserve rejection for every other status mismatch, rewrite, downgrade, or non-later transition. Add restart coverage for both budget phases and negative identity/digest/cursor variants.

findings.title: PENDING retries can rewrite immutable historical observation metadata

evidence.source: For the same non-empty digest, import_bytes revalidates any existing PENDING record. _record then permits any replacement sharing logical_identity while the existing status is PENDING; it does not require an identical PENDING record or restrict the delta to the allowed PENDING-to-OBSERVED completion.
evidence.reproduction: A first restricted OBS-P PENDING record at 08:00 was retried at the strictly later cursor with the same ID, key, logical identity, digest, and content but observed_at 07:00 plus changed license_basis, content_summary, and summary_basis. Both calls returned PENDING; restart loaded cursor c2 and the rewritten 07:00 metadata.

findings.repair: Reject non-identical PENDING-to-PENDING replacement. Define immutable persisted fields and allow only the narrow, validated PENDING-to-OBSERVED completion delta, including the necessary license/artifact transition while preserving timestamp, summary, identity, version, media type, and digest. Add same-process and restart regressions for backward timestamps and descriptive-field rewrites.
